summary: Tehama County, CA CCC lookout cabin built 1936 in Lassen NF, used for WWII aircraft monitoring and later rented; destroyed in the 2024 Park Fire, with only the foundation left.

corrections.proposed: 2024 burned in the Park Fire; keep the 2004 'Removed' value only as a disputed register field
corrections.why: The register descriptions, the Forest Service notice and SFGate all say the lookout burned in the 2024 Park Fire and that the foundation remains. The 2004 field contradicts them

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The NHLR and FFLOS 'Removed' fields say 2004, but the same pages say it burned in the 2024 Park Fire. The Forest Service and SFGate also describe the 2024 fire. The record uses 2024.
NHLR and FFLOS give 3,762 ft (1,147 m). The Forest Service page gives 3,600 feet. The record keeps the register figure and notes the difference.

sources.title: Treasured Northern California wilderness stay destroyed in wildfire

notes_for_editor: The fate is corroborated by three independent sources (NHLR, Forest Service notice, SFGate). No staffing history appears in the sources read, so none is recorded; the WWII monitoring role and the rental are the operating history. The NHLR page carries a March 2025 photo credited to Darin McQuoid, but no image URL was available, so no photo is recorded. Campflare and the Forest Service listing were seen only in search results and are not cited. The Forest Service listing shows 'Site Closed'.
